subject: anglais
title: L'avenir et les projets en l'anglais

questions.question: Quelles phrases parlent de demain ?
options: I am going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
We will have a test tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Tomorrow signifie demain. Yesterday et now ne désignent pas le futur.

questions.question: Tom ___ his bike tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Projet pour demain : be going to + verbe.

questions.question: What are you going to do tomorrow? — Bonne réponse :
options: I am going to do my homework.
questions.explanation: On répond avec be going to + activité.

questions.question: Où place-t-on souvent tomorrow ?
questions.explanation: Exemple : I will call you tomorrow.

questions.question: They ___ to the cinema tomorrow evening.
Je vais lire un livre demain.
options: I am going to read a book tomorrow.
I am read a book tomorrow.
questions.explanation: I am going to read + tomorrow.

questions.question: Phrase correcte :
options: She is going to swim tomorrow.
She is go to swim tomorrow.
questions.explanation: She is going to + verbe de base.

questions.question: Quelles expressions indiquent la semaine prochaine ?
options: We are going to travel next week.

questions.question: Nous aurons des vacances la semaine prochaine.
options: We will have holidays next week.
questions.explanation: We will have holidays next week.

questions.question: Phrase correcte :
options: Next week I going to start school.
Next week I am going to start school.
Next week I am go to start school.
Next week I will going start school.

questions.question: What are you doing next week? — Bonne réponse :
options: I am going to visit my aunt next week.

questions.question: Formes correctes avec be going to :
questions.explanation: Il faut am/is/are avant going to.

questions.question: Be going to sert surtout à :
Ils vont faire du sport.
options: They are going to do sport.
questions.explanation: They are going to do sport.

questions.explanation: Where is she going to go?

questions.question: ___ I going to be late?
questions.explanation: Am I going to be late?

questions.question: Phrases négatives correctes :
options: I am not going to cry.

questions.question: Are they going to stay? — No, ___.
Phrase correcte :
options: She not is going to run.

questions.question: I ___ going to eat sweets tonight.
The boys ___ going to play outside.
Phrases avec will (promesse ou décision) :
questions.explanation: Will + verbe au futur. Yesterday est impossible.

questions.question: Prédictions avec will :
options: I think you will like it.

questions.question: You ___ have fun at the party!

Réponses qui décrivent un projet futur :
options: After school I'm going to meet friends.

questions.question: What are your plans for the weekend?
options: I'm going to ride my bike.

questions.question: This summer I ___ to the beach.
I'm not going to ___ TV all day.
After the lesson I ___ my friend.
We're going to ___ a new game.
Phrases polies pour proposer :
questions.explanation: Would you like + nom = proposition polie.

questions.question: Would you like to ___ football?
questions.explanation: Would you like to + verbe de base.

questions.question: Veux-tu un morceau de gâteau ?
options: Would you like a piece of cake?
questions.explanation: Would you like a piece of cake?

questions.question: Invitations avec Would you like :
options: Would you like to come to my party?
Would you like to join us?
questions.explanation: To + verbe de base. Yesterday impossible.

questions.question: Would you like to come to my house ___ Saturday?
Invitation au cinéma :
options: Would you like to go to the cinema?

questions.question: Would you like to ___ pizza with us?
Veux-tu venir à mon anniversaire ?
options: Would you like to come to my birthday party?

questions.question: Would you like to play video games ___ school?
___ would you like to do tonight?
questions.explanation: What would you like to do?

questions.question: Erreur :
options: Would you like to watch a film?
questions.explanation: Like to + base, pas -ing seul ici.

questions.question: Suggestions avec Let's :
questions.explanation: Let's + verbe base. Pas went ni to eat.

questions.question: Réponses pour accepter une suggestion Let's :
questions.explanation: Yes let's et Good idea acceptent.

questions.question: Refus poli à Let's play now :
Réponse négative douce :
options: I'd love to, but I can't.

questions.question: Formules d'invitation polies :
options: Can you come to my party?
questions.explanation: Want to / Can you come sont polis en 6e.

questions.question: Do you want to ___ with us?

questions.explanation: Love to et sounds fun = oui.

questions.question: Would you like to come? — ___
questions.explanation: Yes, please ou I'd love to.

questions.question: See you ___!
questions.explanation: See you then = À tout à l'heure.

questions.question: What time ___ we meet?

Would you like to come? — Refus :
